risk.summary: The proposed £2.4m secured loan breaches several high‑severity policy limits, notably LTV (82.1% > 75%), DSCR (1.15x < 1.25x), absence of a personal guarantee, and net debt/EBITDA (4.6x > 3.5x). The covenant package is also weaker than required. While the borrower has a solid trading history, adequate security and full documentation, these mitigants do not offset the material quantitative breaches. Consequently the overall risk is assessed as high and the loan should be declined.
